subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Ilvara's detonation
fact: Ilvara Mizzrym ruptured into a massive toxic bloom of poisonous spores, venting demonic corruption all at once.
source_quote: She detonated. Her body ruptured outward in a massive toxic bloom — a cloud of poisonous spores billowing through the cavern in every direction

subject: bridge collapse
fact: The bridge over Velkynvelve was destroyed by Thorin, sending Ilvara and Jorlan crashing to the cavern floor.
source_quote: Thorin had already toppled the bridge, sent both of them crashing to the cavern floor

subject: Dawnbringer radiant pulse
fact: Thorin's Dawnbringer glowed with steady warmth after the battle, having destroyed the heart fungus in two rounds.
source_quote: Dawnbringer pulsed once, steady warmth against my palm

subject: Asha's prayer
fact: Asha Vandree dropped to her knees and began murmuring prayers to Lolth, reshaping the aftermath into theology.
source_quote: Asha Vandree dropped to her knees and began murmuring prayers, her voice the only sound left — words to Lolth, rising from the wreckage

subject: T'sarran retreat
fact: The last House T'sarran warrior stepped back toward the tunnels, declaring 'We will meet again' after witnessing Ilvara's demise and the mage's death.
source_quote: We will meet again," he said. "Enjoy your victory for the moment.

subject: Glabbagool inquiry
fact: Grygum's first real question after the spore cloud thinned was about Glabbagool, indicating its relevance to the aftermath.
source_quote: My first real question, once the cloud was thin enough to breathe through, was about Glabbagool.

subject: Zalthir's teleport strike
fact: Zalthir teleported across the battlefield using shadow-step and struck the T'sarran mage once, killing him instantly.
source_quote: He teleported across the battlefield — shadow-step, the distance closing in the space between one breath and the next — and hit the mage once, and that was enough.

subject: cavern silence
fact: The cavern settled into a thick, spore-choked silence after Ilvara's detonation, with only Asha’s prayers remaining.
source_quote: The cavern settled into a thick, spore-choked silence. The heart fungus was already a collapsed ruin... and somewhere in the settling quiet, Asha Vandree dropped to her knees and began murmuring prayers

subject: Eldritch Claw Tattoo reach
fact: Zalthir’s Eldritch Claw Tattoo has a fifteen-foot reach, yet the distance between him and Ilvara remained insurmountable.
source_quote: He had the Eldritch Claw Tattoo — fifteen feet of reach — but the distance between him and Ilvara was not fifteen feet.

subject: Daz's fireball
fact: Daz had already run an empowered fireball through the last T'sarran mage, singeing him at the edges.
source_quote: Daz had already run an empowered fireball through him; the man was singed at the edges

subject: insect swarm at entrance
fact: An insect swarm remained active at the cavern entrance, requiring attention after the main combatants fell.
source_quote: Someone else was dealing with the insect swarm at the entrance.

subject: Zalthir's internal conflict
fact: Zalthir understood he must not close on Ilvara, a rule he enforced against his own instinct, rooted in the discipline of the Eldritch Claw Tattoo.
source_quote: The spirit of it was that he shouldn't close on her, and he knew the spirit of it, and so he didn't. The discipline is self-administered. Always has been.

subject: Grygum's Guiding Bolt
fact: Grygum cast a Guiding Bolt that struck Ilvara, triggering her catastrophic detonation of demonic corruption.
source_quote: The bolt left my hand. It lanced across the cavern floor in a concentrated column of radiant light and found her where she stood.

subject: heart fungus ruin
fact: The heart fungus was destroyed by Thorin in one devastating round, reduced to a collapsed ruin.
source_quote: The heart fungus was already a collapsed ruin — Thorin had seen to that in one devastating, almost insulting round

subject: Zalthir's final realization
fact: Zalthir realized he was supposed to not be near Ilvara — not a question, but a rule, applied against his own interest.
source_quote: I am supposed to be trying to not be near her. Right. Not a question. Just the rule, stated plainly, applied against his own interest
